name: obsidian-skills
description: Nine self-contained Agent Skills for Obsidian vault work: Obsidian-flavoured Markdown, Bases, JSON Canvas, Mermaid, visual form selection, the official CLI, Web Clipper, vault diagnosis, and vault sync. Version 0.1.0 is a public prerelease: native install and fresh-load are verified on Claude Code in an isolated project scope only, and every other runtime install is unverified. It is the native half of the secondbrain-skills collection; the eleven knowledge packages are listed here as each one lands.
